Coverage and access: Search journal literature and discover open copies. This dashboard uses public, keyless search; larger harvests can use a verified OpenAlex API key.
Search publisher-deposited DOI records, including subscription journals. A DOI links to the registered publication.
Search public health, environmental epidemiology and life sciences. Repository full text is available for a subset.
Find articles whose metadata publishers deposited for journals listed in the Directory of Open Access Journals.
Discover publications linked across repositories, research organizations and projects.
Search refereed journal literature using an ADS/SciX API token.
Search on IEEE Xplore and select journals in Content Type.
The dashboard searches 10.1145 journal articles through Crossref. Search the ACM Digital Library directly for its full catalog.
Open the complete GIM search across the regional Indexes Medici. Journal records from its RIS exports can be imported.
Search in PubMed and apply the Journal Article publication type.

Search FAO AGRIS and filter to journal articles. Its documented machine-access route is the AGRIS Open Dataset (AP/RDF downloads, CC BY 3.0 IGO). The download contains records from participating providers; this dashboard uses the web search for the wider catalog.
Search the SciELO journal network. The dashboard requests its native article RIS export.
The dashboard searches articles registered under the 10.3329 DOI prefix through Crossref. The portal also covers papers with other prefixes or no DOI.
The dashboard searches articles registered under the 10.4314 DOI prefix through Crossref. Search AJOL directly for the wider collection.
Direct search is opt-in and subject to JST’s API conditions. Keyword searches use title words.
Search USGS-authored journal articles on water, hazards and land change. Filter out government reports when collecting journal papers.
Open the repository search and check the published article or manuscript version.
Server search needs a BASE-approved key for non-commercial use and retains records explicitly identified as journal articles. The portal supports wider discovery.
Open the paper search and explore linked citations.
Check the DOI directly from a paper using “Check for a free copy”. Enter your contact email in Sources.
Open the GeoRef provider available through your institution, paste the query, and export selected journal citations.
Sign in to Engineering Village, select GEOBASE and paste the query. Import a permitted citation export.
Open the Scopus document search with institutional access and paste your query.
Open an institutional Web of Science session and paste the query into the Core Collection search.
Open the search in Google Scholar. Use Cite or Zotero to collect individual journal papers.
Open SciSpace or its connected ChatGPT app, copy the research prompt and import the returned journal citations or DOIs.
Search the Consensus API with your key, or take the query into Consensus and import journal citations.
Search the configured workspace with the optional bridge. For wider literature discovery, use your connected app and import its selected citations.
Use metadata search in the optional connected bridge or app. Import citations or paste DOIs to find free copies.
Import a publisher RSS or Atom file. Journal-article evidence is required. For a feed containing titles and DOIs only, paste DOIs into the lookup instead.
Import a page from an OAI-PMH ListRecords response in oai_dc format. Only explicitly identified journal articles are retained. Download further pages using the repository’s resumption token.
Search the personal or group library selected on the server, or import a Zotero export.
Download the included Crossref workflow or generate one for the current query. Import the resulting RIS file here.
Import a SCImago journal CSV and specify its edition year in the rankings panel.
Use your licensed edition and import its permitted ranking rows using the normalized CSV template.
Search DataCite records identified as journal articles. A repository DOI may identify a deposited version.
